## Where
Worktree C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-console-win, branch fix/console-windows (HEAD b2ee1c079), plugin dir plugins/ruflo-console. Windows 11, Node 24. vitest: from plugins/ruflo-console `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/<file>.spec.ts` (node_modules is a git-ignored junction — never commit it). Touch only plugins/ruflo-console. Do not push. Each commit ends with exactly `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <[REDACTED:email]>`. Linux/macOS behaviour must stay byte-identical except where stated. No new dependencies. Do not dispatch subagents.

Background: this branch added hooks/data/paths.ts (isAbsolutePath, joinPath, samePath, isWindowsPath, trimTrailing, hasParentSegment, normalizePath, below, homeOf) and a write flavor 'host-fs' (hooks/data/write-flavor.ts, hooks/data/write-via.ts `writeVia`) used on Windows.

## Findings to fix (with the controller's binding rulings)
1. [Important] Autopilot on host-fs: the duplicate-start guard (hooks/ap-live.ts ~299 `startedCount(journalNow, stepId) !== 1`) relies on atomic appends; on host-fs append is read-then-write so one of two concurrent `step.started` lines can be lost and the same step dispatched twice. AND 2. [Important] On Windows, backslash or drive-letter paths in task text bypass the autopilot folder fence and the envelope-edit hard deny (hooks/data/ap-guard.ts:30 PATH regex, :53; hooks/data/ap-envelope.ts:22 envelope-edit pattern, :339 pathAllowed).
   RULING: gate the autopilot START on host-fs: when the write flavor is 'host-fs', starting autopilot (every entry point: pane button, palette entry, /ruflo command, console_run model tool — find them; they converge on the start path in ap-live.ts / startSpec) is refused with a plain message: "Autopilot is not yet available on Windows: its journal and path fence need atomic appends and Windows-aware path checks (follow-up)." Nothing is written, no step is dispatched. Stop/clear must keep working (a pre-existing KILL flag can still be cleared). Do NOT attempt the full Windows autopilot fix. Tests: on a host-fs fake host each start entry point refuses with that message and writes nothing; on gnu the start behaves exactly as before (existing ap-* specs green). Update any existing test that asserted a host-fs autopilot start succeeds (e.g. write-flavor.spec.ts ~3098 stop→start cycle): keep the KILL clear/seen assertions but expect the start itself to be refused.
3. [Important] Review Focus #2: workspace keys must compare equal regardless of drive-letter case or trailing separator. hooks/state.ts:94 `storeKeyOf` and :173 `termStoreKeyOf` key on the raw cwd.
   RULING: for Windows paths (isWindowsPath) build the key from a canonical form: lower-case, `\`→`/`, trailing separators trimmed. POSIX keys byte-identical. Tests: `c:\users\mariu\` and `C:\Users\mariu` give the same key for both functions; a POSIX cwd key is unchanged (pin today's exact string).
4. [Must-fix minor] tests/paths.spec.ts lacks Windows containment tests. Add: below('C:\\proj','C:\\project\\x') false; below('C:\\proj','C:\\proj\\x') true; below('C:\\proj','c:/PROJ/x') true; below('C:\\proj','D:\\proj\\x') false; UNC below('\\\\srv\\share\\a','\\\\srv\\share\\a\\b') true and ('\\\\srv\\share\\a','\\\\srv\\share\\ab') false; hasParentSegment('C:/a\\..\\b') true; hasParentSegment('\\\\srv\\share\\..\\x') true; samePath('\\\\srv\\share\\x','//srv/share/x') — assert whatever the implementation's documented rule is and say which. If any of these fail, fix paths.ts (that is a real bug) and say so.
5. [PR prep] Per ADR-478: add at the top of plugins/ruflo-console/CHANGELOG.md a `## 0.42.1 — 2026-10-10` section (match the existing heading's exact dash character and format by reading the file first) with `fix:` bullets, newest first, one per user-visible change of this branch (Windows project folders recognised; home folder found on Windows; disk writes on Windows via the host file API; autopilot kill flag clearable / autopilot start refused on Windows until a follow-up; no Linux-only process probe off Linux and probe timers cleared; any confirmed action whose on-disk check fails is re-checked once after 1 s, so a hive started from the console shows at once; workspace keys equal across drive-letter case). Bump `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` "version" from 0.42.0 to 0.42.1. If any other file holds the console version (grep for "0.42.0" inside plugins/ruflo-console, excluding CHANGELOG history), update it consistently and say which.

## Process
TDD for 1–4 (RED then GREEN, run the specs), then 5. Commit as logical commits (e.g. one per finding group). Run at the end: tests/paths.spec.ts, tests/write-flavor.spec.ts, all tests/ap-*.spec.ts, the specs covering state.ts (grep), plus any spec touching files you changed; report counts and compare against HEAD b2ee1c079's known environment-only failures (sibling plugins missing in sparse checkout, symlink EPERM, file modes, '>' in name, claude-code/testing missing, 5000 ms timeouts).

## Report (required)
Write C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-console-win\.superpowers\sdd\2026-10-10-ruflo-console-windows-nav-chat\final-fix-report.md: per finding: change, files, RED/GREEN command + output; spec counts; any paths.ts bug found; concerns.
Then reply ONLY (<15 lines): Status (DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT), commits, one-line test summary, concerns, report path.
